Array Indexing and Bounds

Stage 4 Concept ⏱ 12 min 📖 Glossary

Index 0 is first, length-1 is last. Touching outside is like knocking on a door that does not exist — Java stops you loudly.

🔎 Motivating questionWhy do buildings skip “floor 0” in some countries but programmers love it?

Objectives

  • Use 0-based indexes
  • Explain length vs last index
  • Avoid out-of-bounds

Needs first: Arrays

1 Start with an analogy

Real life first, code second.

Hotel floors 0-4 (5 floors). Last = floors-1 = 4. Knocking on floor 9 → security (exception) escorts you out.

⚠️ Where the analogy breaksWhere it breaks: hotels may forgive. Java never forgives out-of-bounds — instant ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.

2 The concept, plainly

One idea at a time, words before jargon.

First = 0, last = length-1. Loop: i < a.length, never <=.

a[a.length] always crashes. Check bounds before wild indexes.

Use length (arrays) vs length() (strings) — no brackets for arrays!

3 Watch it move: Hotel doors

Step at your pace. Text explains every move.

4 Live code demo

Small, correct Java 17 (LTS) code. Read, trace, copy.

Main.javaJava 17
int[] a = {5, 6, 7};
System.out.println(a[0]);          // 5
System.out.println(a[a.length-1]); // 7
// System.out.println(a[3]); // crash: 0..2 only
▶ Output 5 7
  • First slot 0.
  • Last = length-1.
  • Index 3 missing → crash.
💡 Why this output?Length 3 → doors 0,1,2. Door 3 does not exist.

Change values, watch consequences. Simulation — honest, not a real compiler.

Knock on doors 0-5.

6 Common mistakes (at least 3)

Wrong, why, fixed — learn from realistic slips.

❌ Mistake 1: for (i = 0; i <= a.length; i++)Why: Visits one ghost door.
✅ Fix: i < a.length.
❌ Mistake 2: a.length() with bracketsWhy: Arrays use length (field-like).
✅ Fix: a.length — strings use length().
❌ Mistake 3: Guessing “last = length”Why: Off by one.
✅ Fix: Last = length - 1.

Hints first, solutions only after a real try.

9 Takeaways + next step

  • 0 first, length-1 last.
  • Loop with < length.
  • Outside → loud exception.
🧠 Recall challengeDoors 0..n-1: how many doors for length n?
